history.new: As a conjecture, low confidence - not found; natural attack via Messaoudi's Cor 1 (window stability); related: property (F) implies Pisot (Frougny-Solomyak 1992) (Historian audit 2026-10-18, reviews/historian_C03_C10.md).

If the minimal linear recurrence of an increasing base sequence G (G_0 = 1) has a dominant root alpha > 1 and
another characteristic root beta with |beta| >= 1 (counted with multiplicity: a repeated dominant root counts as
such a beta), then the circle product o_s is non-associative for every s >= 0.

statement:
If the minimal linear recurrence of an increasing base sequence G (G_0 = 1) has a dominant root alpha > 1 and
another characteristic root beta with |beta| >= 1 (counted with multiplicity: a repeated dominant root counts as
such a beta), then the circle product o_s is non-associative for every s >= 0.
title: Circle products over non-Pisot base sequences are never associative
